teams.synopsis: What a crazy MNF comeback for what’s now the top ranked team in the league.
teams.blurb: What a crazy MNF comeback for what’s now the top ranked team in the league. Andrew just narrowly sits at 2nd in total points, but with a 3-2 record he sits atop the DEM conference. N.Y. Routensss has a nice little win streak going now and looks to continue it on Prime Time in Week 6 against the 2nd ranked team, although he’s had a rough going against Anthony in league history. Nevertheless, the team gets back three key contributors from BYE while losing Justin Jefferson to BYE. It’s also interesting to see how the Marvin Harrison Jr. saga in Houston plays out, since that could be a huge wildcard for Andrew down the line. It also is important to note that TreVeyon Henderson will be nursing an ankle injury for a few weeks, leaving the door open for Rhamondre Stevenson to produce RB1 numbers. 2026 has been Andrew’s best season to date and I don’t see why that can’t continue in Week 6 even with the tough competition.

teams.synopsis: Wow, this team looks brand new with both Puka Nacua and Jayden Daniels healthy.
teams.blurb: Wow, this team looks brand new with both Puka Nacua and Jayden Daniels healthy. Unfortunately for Cole, the team is still dealing with some injuries to key players like Ladd McConkey, TreVeyon Henderson, and Stefon Diggs, but the latter may be good to go for Week 6. After Puka Nacua, the WR room is just full of a bunch of solid, but inconsistent players, a healthy consistent WR2 and RB2 could do wonders for this team, especially if Jayden Daniels and Puka Nacua can’t continue to be elite week in and week out. His opponent is short-handed in Week 6, so even though Cole isn’t projected to score a lot this week he will still have a fighting chance. This week is also important because he and Ryan are ranked 8th and 9th, respectively, so the winner will be ranked higher next week. The team has been middling so far, and is projected to stay in that No Man’s Land area, even with the lighter projected strength of schedule for the rest of 2026.

teams.synopsis: The most controversial placement of the year perhaps.
teams.blurb: The most controversial placement of the year perhaps. Ryan lost a heartbreaker during Monday Night Football and because of that loss I’ve had a hard time placing Ryan in the Week 6 Rankings, so I’ve decided to just keep him at 9th. I said it within a lower-ranked team’s blurb, but at this point in the season I’m looking for points scored more so than wins added. I probably would have moved Ryan up if he walked away with the win last night, but since he lost I didn’t move him up, but I also didn’t move him down because he still showed the ability to produce. I’m betting that at some point his luck will turn around and he’ll start to stack some wins and maybe compete for playoff spots, at least that’s the bet I’ll make in Week 6. If he continues to lose then I won’t care how much he scores he simply can’t be ranked highly, but that mindset won’t come into play until at least November. It’s funny, coming into this season Ryan had the “best” schedule luck since 2020 with 10 wins over expected in that timeframe, but in 2026 alone he’s tied for the “worst” schedule luck with 2 wins under expected. Anyway, Week 6 looks like it will be a toss up, especially with Joe Burrow and Aaron Jones Sr. on BYE, but maybe better days are ahead with Emeka Egbuka and Garrett Wilson potentially being the WR duo that Ryan drafted them to be. Week 6 is crucial.

teams.synopsis: Carmine is a tough one to rank, I mean when healthy this team looks incredible on paper, they have a positive record entering Week 6, and the team has had flashes of great performances with three weeks between 112 and 125 points.
teams.blurb: Carmine is a tough one to rank, I mean when healthy this team looks incredible on paper, they have a positive record entering Week 6, and the team has had flashes of great performances with three weeks between 112 and 125 points. But on the other hand, the team just put up a dud in Week 5 and showed a tremendously low floor in Week 2. Still, I think the Week 5 performance was a fluke for what’s to come when Breece Hall and DJ Moore are healthy. Drake Maye also looks to be turning it around, making it so Carmine has two top 14 QBs on his roster. A potential trade starter? Now, the team gets an absolutely brutal matchup in Week 6 against a Baylen team that may just go nuclear, but never say never. It’s not like Carmine is 1-4 and can’t afford to lose, even if he does lose in Week 6 I think the team is primed to make a push for the playoffs once again.

teams.synopsis: Nice, a new season high for The Gegwich Effect with 125.2 points in Week 5, 18 points more than his second best week in 2026.
teams.blurb: Nice, a new season high for The Gegwich Effect with 125.2 points in Week 5, 18 points more than his second best week in 2026. It was a nail bitter in Week 5 for the team, winning by 1.11 points which is tied for the closest matchup of the season so far. The season-high performance was led by his two Giants players, Isaiah Likely and Malik Nabers, which must continue to produce if Quin wants to win more games this season. The team now averages more than 100 points per week, which is definitely a nice threshold to be over, but it’s going to take more performances like their Week 5 to keep moving this team up the ranks. Quin will be without his first round pick in Week 6 due to BYE but the team is hopeful to get Devonta Smith back and maybe Woody Marks can take a leap in Week 6 while David Montgomery likely sits. The matchup is not expected to be a super tough one, but who knows what will happen. Quin is also projected to have one of the easiest rest of season schedules, like how I’ve been saying almost every week, so maybe this positive record with low point totals is here to stay.

teams.synopsis: Oh boy, I guess I jinxed him when I said 2026 was better to him than I expected it to be.
teams.blurb: Oh boy, I guess I jinxed him when I said 2026 was better to him than I expected it to be. Despite Bucky Irving and Trey McBride putting together a couple of great performances, the 5th best RB performance and 4th best TE performances for Deniz all-time, the team still failed to clear 90 points on the week. Things don’t look any better in Week 6 either, with Amon-Ra St. Brown on BYE the team will have to start some fliers and question marks at WR and FLEX. The team has yet to make playoffs since 2022 and with the hardest projected strength of schedule for the rest of 2026 I wouldn’t be surprised if they miss it once again. Good luck to Deniz.

teams.synopsis: For beating the top ranked team I’ll move Max up a spot to 13th.
teams.blurb: For beating the top ranked team I’ll move Max up a spot to 13th. Tee’d Up is the only team to average less than 100 points per week through the first five weeks of the 2026 season, so despite the 3-2 record I simply can’t have the team much higher than this. At this point of the season I’m looking more so at points scored than wins added, but if the team continues to win while putting up subpar numbers than I’ll have to move them, but until then I think 13th is fine. Once again, it was Derrick Henry that led the way for the team, he’s now up to 544.3 points scored all-time for Max, which is the 3rd most for any manager in Preach history. Alongside Derrick Henry in Week 5 was Spencer Shrader, the best kicker in fantasy in 2026. With the Week 5 win in the past, Max looks to take down another top team in the league, which looks doable now that Jahmyr Gibbs is on BYE for Charlie’s team. Max will be without Tee Higgins and most likely KC Concepcion, but Saquon Barkley may be returning in Week 6 to give the team a boost. 13th is fair for now, but if Max finds a way to win again in Week 6 and possible put up a boom week score then I’ll have no choice but to raise the rank in Week 7.

teams.synopsis: Sorry Brandon, I feel that I have to put you this low despite not having the lowest points per game nor the worst record.
teams.blurb: Sorry Brandon, I feel that I have to put you this low despite not having the lowest points per game nor the worst record. The Minutemen have scored less and less points each week, culminating in three straight losses and a season low of 86.40 points in Week 5. #14 is also the lowest rank Brandon has had... ever, so yeah not a great place to be. The reinforcements are coming though. The team gets Rashee Rice and Jalen Coker back in Week 6 after their teams spent the week on BYE, so it’s plausible the team can bounce back in Week 6 against a tough opponent. We’ve seen The Minutemen have a poor start to the season before, last year the team started 2-3 through five weeks and then went 4-5 after that point and missed playoffs by a smidge, but in 2021 the team started 1-4 through five weeks and then went 8-0 after that point. Which way will the franchise’s 2026 season go?
